keyword.en: order Electric 60 Concrete Pump from the Xingtai catalogue sheet
keyword.zh: 按邢台目录页订购电动60型混凝土泵

title.en: Put the Electric 60 Concrete Pump Page on the Inquiry, Then Ask Xingtai for the Price
title.zh: 询盘写上电动60型混凝土泵的页面，价格向邢台确认

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric 60 at /products/electric-60-concrete-pump: 90 kW, 40 m³/h, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 3300 kg. The catalogue sheet is not a price list. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60列在 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump：90 kW、40 m³/h、细石 200 m / 600 m、3300 kg。目录图不是价目表。价格向邢台询盘确认。

h1.en: The Electric 60 Concrete Pump Order Uses the Printed Page, Not a Guess
h1.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵的订单以已印页面为准

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Electric 60 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-60-concrete-pump. The picture on this note is the catalogue layout kept with that model. It is not a price list. Copy the cells that page prints: Model Electric 60; Motor Power 90 kW; Theoretical Output 40 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 35 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.7 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 112; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. Hopper capacity is 0.7 m³. Theoretical output is printed as 40 m³/h. Send mix or material, maximum aggregate, the output you need, horizontal and vertical distance, diesel or the site voltage and frequency, country and purchase timing. The price is not on the page. Confirm the price with Xingtai at /contact. A related note in this set is /blog/buy-electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60型混凝土泵列在 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。 这篇配图是该型号留下的目录版式。它不是价目表。抄该页已印的格子：型号 Electric 60、电机功率 90 kW、理论输送量 40 m³/h、最大出口压力 35 MPa、料斗容积 0.7 m³、细石输送（水平/垂直） 200 m / 600 m、13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m、24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m、液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 112、外形尺寸 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、整机重量 3300 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，以及整机重量 3300 kg。料斗容积是 0.7 m³。理论输送量印的是 40 m³/h。同时发送材料或配合比、最大骨料、需要的输送量、水平与垂直距离、柴油或现场电压和频率、国家与采购时间。页面上没有价格。价格向邢台询盘确认，用 /contact。本批相关说明见 /blog/buy-electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry。

heading.en: What to copy from this page

body.en: Name /products/electric-60-concrete-pump in the subject line. The published row is: Model Electric 60; Motor Power 90 kW; Theoretical Output 40 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 35 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.7 m³; Fine Stone Conveying (H / V) 200 m / 600 m; 13 mm Stone (H / V) 150 m / 450 m; 24 mm Stone (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki double pump 112; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and Main Unit Weight 3300 kg. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。已公布的一行是：型号 Electric 60、电机功率 90 kW、理论输送量 40 m³/h、最大出口压力 35 MPa、料斗容积 0.7 m³、细石输送（水平/垂直） 200 m / 600 m、13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 150 m / 450 m、24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m、液压泵 Kawasaki double pump 112、外形尺寸 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、整机重量 3300 kg。运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，以及整机重量 3300 kg。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Power and line size on the same note
heading.zh: 同一封里的动力和管路

body.en: Motor power on this page is 90 kW. The page does not print a voltage cell, so the inquiry still carries the site voltage and frequency. Do not invent a voltage. This page does not print a delivery-pipe diameter. Leave that cell blank on the order and confirm the size with Xingtai if the job needs pipe.
body.zh: 这一页的电机功率是 90 kW。页面没有电压格，所以询盘仍要带上现场电压和频率。不要自填电压。这一页没有印输送管径。订单上这一格留空；如果工程要配管子，向邢台确认尺寸。

body.en: Confirm the price with Xingtai. The page does not print a list price, a production-day count, a certificate name or a list of export countries. Equipment on these pages ships from Xingtai. The category answers do not claim an overseas warehouse. Write to /contact, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Another page in this set is /blog/buy-electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry.
body.zh: 价格向邢台询盘确认。页面不印标价、不印生产天数、不印证书名称，也不印出口国名单。这些页面上的设备从邢台发货。分类说明不声称有海外仓。写信到 /contact、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。本批另一篇是 /blog/buy-electric-low-pressure-60-concrete-pump-catalogue-sheet-inquiry。

answer.en: It is not printed on the Electric 60 Concrete Pump page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
answer.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵页面上没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

question.en: Which address do I put on the inquiry?

answer.en: Put /products/electric-60-concrete-pump. That path selects this row. The contact page is /contact.
answer.zh: 写上 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump。这条路径选定这一行。联系页是 /contact。

question.en: What weight do I give the forwarder?

answer.en: For transport, the page prints Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and Main Unit Weight 3300 kg.
answer.zh: 运输一栏，页面印的是外形尺寸 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm，以及整机重量 3300 kg。

question.en: Can I add a certificate or a delivery date?
question.zh: 可以补上证书或交货日期吗？

answer.en: The page does not print a certificate name or a production-day count. Ask Xingtai in the same inquiry, and do not fill those cells yourself.
answer.zh: 页面没有印证书名称，也没有印生产天数。在同一封询盘里问邢台，不要自己填这些格子。

question.en: Which hopper volume is on this row?
question.zh: 这一行的料斗容积是多少？

answer.en: The page prints 0.7 m³. Use that figure with /products/electric-60-concrete-pump.
answer.zh: 页面印的是 0.7 m³。与 /products/electric-60-concrete-pump 一起使用这个数字。
